mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate over the past 1 month (measured as the change in FEDFUNDS from t-1mo to t) predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, as lower rates reduce the cost of capital and increase the present value of future equity cash flows.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns in periods where FEDFUNDS declined by more than 0.1% over the past month are not significantly higher than the baseline (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 4.5% (as of t-1mo), it signals a restrictive monetary policy stance that increases the risk-free rate and compresses equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns in periods where FEDFUNDS > 4.5% are not significantly lower than the baseline (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in the federal funds rate and the CPI (measured as FEDFUNDS > 0.2% change and CPIAUCSL > 0.3% change over the past month) indicates a tightening monetary policy amid persistent inflation, which triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to increased real interest rates and reduced risk appetite.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns in periods where both FEDFUNDS increased by more than 0.2% and CPIAUCSL increased by more than 0.3% over the past month are not significantly lower than the baseline (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansion regimes (defined by GDP growth above 2% and housing starts above 1200 units), the S&P 500 exhibits positive forward returns over the next 60 trading days as the economy approaches peak growth and corporate earnings accelerate, but the signal weakens as the cycle matures.
failure_condition: The 60-day forward returns in periods where GDPC1 > 18900 and HOUST > 1200 are not significantly higher than the baseline (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 4.0% (as of t-1mo), it signals a deteriorating labor market that increases the risk of recession and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to reduced consumer spending and corporate earnings.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns in periods where UNRATE > 4.0% are not significantly lower than the baseline (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the industrial production index falls below 100 (as of t-1mo), it indicates a contraction in the manufacturing sector that reduces economic growth expectations and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns in periods where INDPRO < 100 are not significantly lower than the baseline (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE change > 0.2 percentage points) and decline in employment (PAYEMS change < -0.1%) over the past month indicates a deteriorating labor market that triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days due to heightened recession risks and reduced consumer confidence.
failure_condition: The 5-day forward returns in periods where UNRATE change > 0.2 and PAYEMS change < -0.1 are not significantly lower than the baseline (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts fall below 1200 units (as of t-1mo), it signals a contraction in the residential construction sector that reduces consumer confidence and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The 60-day forward returns in periods where HOUST < 1200 are not significantly lower than the baseline (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.
